title: Spikers' Turf: Cabstars, Savouge stop two-game slide

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — AEP-Cabstars and Savouge Spin Doctors snapped their two-game skid to finally enter the win column in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday at Filoil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Japan V.League import Leo Aringo helped the Cabstars overcome Ranran Abdilla’s 37-point explosion for the Armed Forces of the Philippines, 26-28, 25-20, 25-17, 25-18. Aringo lifted AEP from a lethargic first set, hitting 22 kills for 23 points, while steadying the floor with 22 excellent receptions.
